title: VMF runs the schedule pass checks
description: SCHEDULE-PASS-DUE-1. The record at the top of the run store of the runs the service's five-minute schedule pass checks. The product adds a run (Add-VmfRunScheduleDue, from the cmdlet that writes the fact, or the service) after an engine start of a wave, a restore or a finish, after a schedule is saved, after a plan sign-off, after a decision or a retry of a machine, and after Resume. The pass keeps a run while one of its checks acts on it, and removes it when none does - only while the entry holds the mark id the pass read, with one version-checked write. Once an hour the pass checks every run in the store and adds any run a check acts on. The schedule pass reads it. MIGRATION NOTE: new in schema 1; with no record, the pass checks every run and writes it.

runs.description: One entry for each run, in ordinal order of run id.

markId.description: A new value at each mark. The pass removes the entry only while it holds the value the pass read, so a mark written while the pass checks the run is never lost.

reason.description: What added the run: an engine start, a schedule saved, a plan sign-off, a decision or a retry of a machine, Resume, or the hourly check of every run.

holdUntilUtc.description: Until this time the pass keeps the run whatever it finds: 15 minutes after an engine start, because Azure can list a new execution late.

nextUtc.description: The pass checks the run again at this time. Null: at the next pass. A time only when the run has nothing but a scheduled wave whose time has not come.
